name: Residential Support Subsidy
description: Financial assistance product for clients receiving residential support services, covering qualifications, payment structures, application processes, and related extra help entitlements.

attributes.summary: Financial subsidy supporting individuals in residential care services, including payment to partners in the community, provisions for sole parents, children's care payments, and associated extra help entitlements.
attributes.payment_details: Covers personal allowance, increased payment to partner in community, sole parent provisions, and payment for children's care. Includes provisions for clients with other income, debts, or payees.
